Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subtitle: Didn't find your answer? Call us or write on Telegram.

experience.q: Do I need prior experience to start?
experience.a: No. Our courses are split by level — from absolute beginner to advanced. At the free consultation we'll pick the track that matches your level.

format.q: What format are the classes in?
format.a: Classes are held in person at our center in Samarkand (11 Dahbed street). Every topic is reinforced with hands-on lab work on real equipment.

certificate.q: Do I get a certificate at the end?
certificate.a: Yes. Every student who successfully completes a course receives a NETLAB certificate.

price.q: How much do the courses cost?
price.a: Pricing depends on the track and duration. Call us or leave a request — we'll answer all your questions at the free consultation.

job.q: Do you help with finding a job?
job.a: Yes. We help graduates with CV preparation, interview practice and finding suitable openings.

enroll.a: Fill in the form on the site, call us or write on Telegram — our operator will contact you with all the details.
